item.title: Implement the specified thread-safe ledger API
item.brief:
Implement ledger.py exactly according to SPEC.md, preserve documented API and every specified error/boundary case, and add focused tests beyond the existing basics. Use only the Python standard library. Run the focused test suite and commit the work on the assigned branch. Acceptance: constructor validation/copy behavior, amount validation before account lookup, unknown-account KeyError, atomic successful/failed transfers, same-account semantics, snapshot copy isolation, per-account overflow ceiling, and linearizable thread-safe transfers/snapshots without deadlock. Do not push or override git identity.

## Amendment (2026-11-20 10:15 UTC)

Add focused tests for all specified validation, copy isolation, boundaries, same-account behavior and concurrency. Run the tests and commit on the assigned branch.
